$description: Rhythm/position rules. Every rule id is implemented in schema/semantic_validate.py (verify_all checks the two sets are equal).

rules.rule: Exactly one HERO-category node per page, in region main.
rules.exception: None: the only template (template.home) has one hero.

rules.rule: The HERO is the first node of region main.
Regions appear in order pre-main -> main -> post-main.
conversion.demo-form is the last node of main, immediately before shell.footer (measured order: ... faq, cta#demo, footer).
retrievalEligible:false nodes (skip link, loader, progress, grain, mobile menu) live only in region pre-main.
At most one runtime.intro-loader, and it precedes shell.navbar.
At most one node uses pinned-scrub-timeline (the source has exactly one pin among 77 ScrollTriggers).
At most two autoplay patterns (tilt-scrub-autocycle, tabs-autoplay) per page.
Two consecutive main nodes should not share a semantic category.
rules.exception: None observed; measured sequence alternates categories.

rules.rule: Two consecutive night/night-2 nodes break the paper/night rhythm.
rules.exception: conversion.demo-form -> shell.footer (measured: cta#demo night then footer night-2).
